title: Precision of Treatment Effects at a Fixed True Propensity Score
banked_reason: Not salvageable within scope — bank downgraded. Sound matched original-record precision frontiers achieve subfield, below the mandatory field floor; projected paper score ceiling 7.1 < 7.4.
gap_reasons: The theorem remains a fixed-smoothness, public-uniform-design, near-identity-score benchmark in dimensions one through four, and its dimension-four interval remains the full target range until approximately 3×10^79 observations, so the package establishes theoretical precision scales rather than usable application uncertainty.

Relative to [Wu et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.27685), the contribution is the all-procedure converse, singleton-versus-positive-dimensional fiber distinction and unconditional learned-causal-signal attainment, rather than a new correction or exponent.
The [Chen–Gao](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.12673) comparison excludes direct propensity value-trace substitution, while leaving alternative representations unaudited.
proof_attempt_summary: The D0 derivation established matched original-record absolute-risk and honest-length rates n^(-2/5) for unknown scores in d=1, n^(-2/7) in d=2..4, and n^(-2/5) for revealed scores on the frozen primitive class. Source attestation, mathematical review, maximality review, and a neutral independent validity audit passed, but D0.5 rated the package subfield with score ceiling 7.1 below the field cutoff 7.4; no bounded within-scope salvage remained. No F stages or Lean formalization ran; this bank contains reviewed mathematical derivations, not Lean-certified theorems.
tldr: For the causal effect among individuals with true college-completion propensity one half, learning the conditioning score has a sharp precision price on the entire supplied primitive smoothness balls. With original binary records, the matched absolute-risk and uniformly finite-sample honest connected-interval scales are \(n^{-2/5}\) in dimension one, \(n^{-2/7}\) in dimensions two through four, and \(n^{-2/5}\) throughout when the score is revealed. Total data-only procedures and all-procedure converses use the same primitive class. The score-information ratio is one for singleton fibers and \(n^{4/35}\) for positive-dimensional fibers. The root-preserving lower pair satisfies Wu's global law-level score-regression and causal regularity, so its converse transfers to every Wu-style causal class containing it, including the audited auxiliary-sample original-record experiment. The upper theorem remains on the explicit primitive class. Wu's correction and exponent, classical derivative estimation, and known-score calibration receive credit; the field-tier headline is the unknown-score coarea precision price.
gap: Wu obtains corrected local and sieve upper bounds and explicitly leaves minimax negative results open; simplified bounds impose fitted-score residual restrictions. Chen--Gao supplies thin-set calibration only under its applicable representation and remainder hypotheses. Its Assumption 6 requires both a bounded weighted value-trace derivative and a relative remainder bound preventing cancellation of first-order separation. Those hypotheses cannot be inferred for the unknown-score coarea ratio from its regular level set alone.
fill: The answer-open unknown-score frontier joins coarea perturbation analysis, legal treatment-likelihood converses, joint causal cancellation and a certified unconditional pilot-to-risk ledger. A separate revealed-score calibration fixes the surface and uses a bounded inverse-propensity signal; finite-sample causal risk and honesty there remain explicit obligations rather than novelty claims.
